sources.title: Diophantine approximations and continued fractions
sources.locator: p1, lines18-52 in returned PDF extraction
sources.review: Rational centers have a nonzero-fraction separation bound; irrational centers have infinitely many reduced exponent2 approximants. This supports the Dirichlet branch, not a general arbitrary-tolerance claim.

sources.title: The Duffin-Schaeffer Conjecture for multiplicative Diophantine approximation
sources.review: Almost-everywhere multidimensional multiplicative approximation with coprimality and a divergence criterion. Contextual modern reference; not the pointwise finite-fiber reduction lemma under review.
